g.text: AI-powered terminal and Telegram assistant for understanding, planning, and modifying codebases.
Run CLI workflows, ask questions about your project, generate implementation plans, and control coding t…
ByteClaw is a developer assistant that combines terminal workflows, AI planning, local project understanding, and Telegram control.
Designed for fast local workflows with clean prompts,
AI-powered planning, and remote Telegram control.
Built with ✦ by Ujjwal Kumar Kannojiya
